name: Matsutake Meat Rolls

descriptions.normal: A pan-fried meat dish. Ground meat is put on the Matsutake and gently pan-fried on low heat so the Matsutake can fully take in the aromatic juice of the meat. It's a mouthwatering delicacy in all of its glory.
descriptions.suspicious: A pan-fried meat dish. Though the dry and tough texture is miles away from what it could be, the Matsutake is too nutritious to let it go to waste.
descriptions.delicious: A pan-fried meat dish. It combines the essences of the mountains and the nourishments of the celestial bodies. It is a very nutritious dish that will surely bring a smile to your face.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 22% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 20% of Max HP and an additional 900 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 24% of Max HP and an additional 1,500 HP to the selected character.

recipeHint: Complete step 2 of Custodian of Clouds
